install:
set -euo pipefail

# Workspace root differs between agent VMs and environment builds.
# Leave with 0 when montage-studio is not in this checkout.
studio=""
if [ -f scripts/cloud/setup.sh ]; then
  studio="."
fi
if [ -z "$studio" ]; then
  for candidate in \
    /agent/repos/montage-studio \
    /workspace/repos/montage-studio \
    montage-studio \
    ../montage-studio \
    /workspace/montage-studio
  do
    if [ -f "${candidate}/scripts/cloud/setup.sh" ]; then
      studio="${candidate}"
      break
    fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$studio" ]; then
  echo "montage-studio checkout not found; skipping bake"
  exit 0
fi
cd "$studio"

apt_cmd=()
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  apt_cmd=(sudo)
fi
packages=()
if ! python3 -c 'import ensurepip' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  packages+=(python3-venv)
fi
if ! command -v fc-cache >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  packages+=(fontconfig)
fi
if [ "${#packages[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  "${apt_cmd[@]}" apt-get update -qq
  "${apt_cmd[@]}" apt-get install -y -qq "${packages[@]}"
fi

# setup.sh reports whether credential env vars are present and may restore
# logins. Run it without those variables so values are neither used nor printed.
# It does not call paid image, voice, or video APIs.
env \
  -u CURSOR_API_KEY \
  -u OPENMONTAGE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID \
  -u OPENMONTAGE_DRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET \
  -u OPENMONTAGE_DRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN \
  -u OPENMONTAGE_DRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER_ID \
  bash scripts/cloud/setup.sh

# setup.sh installs the Playwright Python package and skips the browser download.
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source scripts/cloud/runtime.sh
if [ ! -x "${REMOTION_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE:-}" ]; then
  .venv/bin/python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source scripts/cloud/runtime.sh
fi

if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then
  echo "Python venv is missing after setup" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d remotion-composer/node_modules ]; then
  echo "Remotion node_modules is missing after setup" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s "${HOME}/.local/share/fonts/openmontage-jp/NotoSansJP.ttf" ]; then
  echo "Noto Sans JP is missing after setup" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -x "${REMOTION_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE:-}" ]; then
  echo "Chromium is missing after Playwright install" >&2
  exit 1
fi

exit 0
